training_task: Detected allelic effects in selected human excitatory-neuron reporter constructs
caveats: No exact project variants were tested in the source assay. Embedding proximity is not a gene interaction, shared disease mechanism, or individual risk. These are exploratory outputs from the fine-tuned model, regardless of which model is recommended by validation. Standardized-feature/clipping diagnostics flag numerical extrapolation only; they do not establish biological in-distribution status.
